bills.title: Paid Parental Leave Amendment (More Support for Working Families) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-03-18.52.1) introduced by ACT Senator [David Pocock](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/david_pocock) (Independent), which means they failed. The amendments related to small business employers who employ fewer than 20 employees at a time. These amendments were moved because [previous amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-03-18.25.1) were unsuccessful. ### Amendment text See [OpenAustralia.org.au](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-03-18.52.1) for the amendment text.
